response.query: How does audit quality moderate the military-director—earnings-management link, and which audit-quality proxies drive the moderation most strongly?
response.answer: High audit quality reduces the link between military-director earnings management; audit quality proxies like auditor reputation and expertise drive this moderation most strongly.
